summary: Use one reusable thread conversation in the native Inbox, agent, mission and tab views

replay.detail: The TUI reads the daemon history and preserves existing conversation drafts and ordinary agent history.

schema.detail: This native presentation adds no stored claim format.

rules.detail: Actions use the selected connection authority and shared SDK signing. Ordinary delivery, attachments and outbox behavior are preserved.

compatibility.detail: The current TUI requires generic Inbox threads-v1 version 2 and the exact summary feed. Start embeds the same composer locally; multiple sibling threads collapse to a single header line. Closed threads still accept ordinary replies and quotes. Rename, Close, Reopen, explicit visible-message read and Recently closed use the same durable thread identity. Original signed requests, keys and fences are retained for visible Retry after an unknown outcome. Old pseudo-chat Inbox sends are replaced by durable threads, including revision feedback; typed approval/rejection remains separate.

downtime.detail: Updating the TUI does not restart the daemon.

manual.detail: Upgrade with the current daemon and other clients before enabling writes. An older daemon shows the existing upgrade feedback; missing permissions and disabled writes remain distinct.

recovery.detail: Keep the original retained Retry for an unconfirmed action instead of starting a replacement. Existing history, pairings and legitimate drafts are preserved; no data reset is required.
